caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a man standing on a square wooden pedestal. The man is dressed in period clothing, including a blue-gray, ruffled shirt with wide, turned-back cuffs, a brown waistcoat, brown trousers, and knee-high boots. A long blue sash is draped diagonally from his left shoulder to his waist. He wears a three-cornered hat decorated with a large feather, and his facial features and curly hair are detailed in shades of brown and gray. The figure's right hand is placed over his chest, while his left arm rests on a stack of barrels or crates at his side. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no landscape or additional objects.
title: Trapper Indian
